data.title: Comstock Announces Grand Opening of Ebbitt House at Reston Station
data.description:
Comstock Holding Companies, Inc. () (“Comstock”), a leading real estate company specializing in the development, acquisition, operation, and management of mixed-use, transit-oriented properties and data center developments, today announced the grand opening of Ebbitt House at Reston Station. Located at 1860 Reston Row Plaza in The Row at Reston Station, the 12,000-square-foot restaurant opens its doors to the public today at 11 a.m. and will welcome guests daily. Reservations are now open via EbbittHouse.com and OpenTable.

Named after the original 1856 boarding house that gave rise to the legendary Old Ebbitt Grill, Ebbitt House marks the first-ever expansion of the storied brand outside of downtown D.C. in its 170-year history. Designed as a contemporary evolution of the D.C. landmark, the venue brings the signature Clyde’s Restaurant Group (“CRG”) hospitality, classic American fare, lively bar culture, and renowned raw bar to Northern Virginia’s premier mixed-use, transit-oriented neighborhood.

Ebbitt House features more than 400 seats spread across its 275+ guest dining room, two private dining rooms, and all-season patio. Two indoor bars anchor the main dining areas that are complemented by a dedicated outdoor patio bar. A full oyster and raw bar sits at the heart of the restaurant, carrying forward one of Old Ebbitt Grill’s best-known traditions, alongside a menu of elevated American classics that have drawn generations of guests to the original. Located steps from the Wiehle-Reston East Station on Metro's Silver Line, Ebbitt House is positioned as a destination for business lunches, after-work gatherings, and celebratory events alike.

“Ebbitt House is one of the most anticipated restaurant openings in Northern Virginia's history, and we are proud that CRG chose Reston Station for the first-ever expansion of such an iconic brand,” said Tim Steffan, Chief Operating Officer of Comstock. “Its arrival, alongside the JW Marriott Reston Station and our growing roster of best-in-class dining and retail, further cements Reston Station as the premier place to live, work, stay, and gather in the Dulles Corridor.”

The opening of Ebbitt House in Reston Station also marks CRG’s return to the area. CRG previously operated Clyde’s of Reston at Reston Town Center for more than 30 years, and several familiar faces from that team have rejoined to lead Ebbitt House, including General Manager Ajay Bhatia and Executive Chef Diego Ramirez.

"Reston has always held a special place in our history, and we are thrilled to return to this thriving community with a bold new chapter of the Ebbitt story," said John McDonnell, President and CEO of Clyde’s Restaurant Group. "Ebbitt House honors and expands upon the traditions guests love about Old Ebbitt Grill, from our renowned raw bar to our classic American hospitality, while introducing an elevated menu and an energetic, modern space tailored specifically for Reston Station."

Reston Station is among the largest and most prominent mixed-use, transit-oriented developments in the Mid-Atlantic region, covering approximately 90 acres spanning across the Dulles Toll Road and surrounding the Wiehle-Reston East Station on Metro’s Silver Line. Its first two phases feature five Trophy-Class office buildings, two luxury high-rise apartment towers, and Virginia’s first and only JW Marriott – a 28-story tower that includes the world-class JW Marriott Reston Station hotel and the ultra-premium JW Marriott Residences, both of which set the new standard for luxury in the D.C. region. A growing collection of signature dining, retail, and wellness options include Ebbitt House, Founding Farmers, Davio’s Northern Italian Steakhouse, Starbucks, a 55,000-square-foot VIDA Fitness and Spa, CVS, and more. For more information, please visit RestonStation.com.

About Comstock

Comstock () is a leading real estate company specializing in the development, acquisition, operation, and management of mixed-use, transit-oriented properties and data center developments. With over four decades of industry expertise, Comstock’s vertically integrated operating platform delivers long-term value across a rapidly growing portfolio of premier properties that includes two of the most prominent mixed-use, transit-oriented developments in the Mid-Atlantic region. Leveraging its scalable, asset-light, debt-free business model, Comstock has strategically expanded into large-scale AI and digital infrastructure development and established an active position in one of the real estate industry's top-performing segments. For more information, please visit Comstock.com.

data.title: Calabash Brings Its Day-to-Night Dining Vision to Life with Square
data.description:
Square today announced that Calabash, the Afro-Caribbean brasserie and bakery from acclaimed chef Camari Mick, has selected Square to power its day-to-night restaurant concept in New York City. Offering a bakery and brunch service by day and a full-service restaurant by night, Calabash chose Square for its ability to support each part of the business on one platform.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261118215743/en/

Photo of Chef Camari Mick, courtesy of Square

Located at 183 Christopher Street in the West Village, Calabash is Chef Mick’s first solo venture following her work as executive pastry chef at The Musket Room and Raf’s. A four-time James Beard Award semifinalist, Mick created Calabash to celebrate the food traditions and communities of the Black Atlantic. Her menu brings this vision to life through dishes including cornbread pancakes with salted maple sabayon and suya steak frites, pairing plantain fries with a suya-spiced au poivre sauce inspired by Nigerian suya. The space also features artwork by Black, Indigenous, and People of Color (BIPOC) women artists curated by gallerist Cierra Britton, extending the restaurant’s cultural storytelling beyond the plate.

One platform, from bakery counter to dinner service

Opening Calabash meant finding technology that could support two distinct service styles and consumer expectations, as the day begins with coffee and pastry orders, before transitioning to brunch, then giving way to seasonal prix-fixe dinners and carefully crafted nonalcoholic cocktails. By selecting Square, Calabash was able to meet the demands of a hotly-anticipated restaurant in one of New York City’s buzziest neighborhoods. Square for Restaurants and Square KDS help drive seamless front- and back-of-house operations. Square Register serves the bakery counter, while Square Stand supports lunch and dinner service. Together, these tools give Calabash options for serving guests throughout the day without fitting its concept around a single service model.

“Calabash is a place for my community and a way to celebrate our food on our own terms,” said Camari Mick, founder of Calabash. “That vision takes different forms throughout the day. We wanted technology that could support all of it, and a team we could build a relationship with as we find our footing. That’s what drew us to Square.”

Beyond the tools themselves, Calabash chose Square for its commitment to helping sellers navigate everyday challenges and adapt as their businesses evolve. For Mick, that long-term lens was an important part of choosing the platform for her first restaurant.

“Camari has a clear vision for Calabash, and any technology should support that vision, not limit it,” said James Schonzeit, Head of Food & Beverage at Square. “Whether the team is serving pastries in the morning or welcoming groups for dinner, Square’s versatility works to support it all. We’re proud to have worked with Calabash from the beginning of their entrepreneurial journey, and to support the team as the business takes shape in New York’s dining scene.”

To learn more about how Square powers food and beverage businesses, visit squareup.com/restaurants.

About Calabash

Calabash is an Afro-Caribbean brasserie and bakery founded by chef Camari Mick in New York City’s West Village. Celebrating the food traditions and communities of West Africa, the Caribbean, and the Eastern Seaboard of the United States, Calabash serves coffee, pastries, and brunch by day from Thursday - Sunday followed by a seasonal a la carte dinner menu on Friday and Saturday evenings, with a nonalcoholic wine and mocktail list. The restaurant is located at 183 Christopher Street.

About Square

Square helps businesses turn transactions into connections and businesses into neighborhood favorites.

In 2009, Square started with a simple invention – the first mobile card reader, which changed how the entire financial system thinks about small businesses. Square has since grown into a global business platform helping millions of sellers of all sizes participate and thrive in their communities. Whether independently run or a global chain, Square understands that sellers succeed when they have the freedom to focus on the experiences that keep customers coming back. From point of sale and payments to online commerce, staff management, cash flow tools, and more, Square brings together the tools sellers need to run and grow on one intelligent platform. For more information, visit squareup.com.

data.title: Bayer’s SUNHARBO® (asundexian) Now Available in the United States
data.description:
Bayer announced today that SUNHARBO® (asundexian), 50 mg tablets, is now available to order in the United States. Hospitals, health systems and pharmacies have immediate access to order the product for inventory. SUNHARBO is the first approved Factor XIa inhibitor in the U.S. and represents the first in a new class of medicine.1

SUNHARBO is indicated in combination with antiplatelet therapy to reduce the risk of stroke in adults with recent non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke (NIH Stroke Scale ≤ 15) or high-risk transient ischemic attack (TIA).1

BAYER EXECUTIVE COMMENTARY
“The swift availability of SUNHARBO reinforces our commitment to patients,” said Nelson Ambrogio, President of Bayer U.S. Pharmaceuticals. “We are proud of the progress Bayer has made in bringing forward a new option for secondary stroke prevention.”

EXPERT COMMENTARY
“I want to see new secondary stroke prevention therapies available to healthcare professionals and their patients as quickly as possible,” said Mike Sharma, M.D., Principal investigator of the Population Health Research Institute (PHRI) OCEANIC-STROKE study, Senior Scientist at PHRI, and Director of the Stroke Program at Hamilton Health Sciences. “Now that SUNHARBO can be ordered for pharmacy inventory in the U.S., let’s recognize that we are taking another great step forward toward that goal.”

To support patients, Bayer is offering several programs designed to facilitate therapy initiation and continuity of care, including co-pay offers and patient education. For more information, visit here: https://www.sunharbosavings.com/.

The list price for SUNHARBO will be $748.50 for a 30-day supply. The list price does not reflect what most health plans or patients will pay. Costs will vary by health plan, and patients’ out-of-pocket costs will depend on their coverage, such as deductibles and copays. The list price may be subject to change without prior notifications.

Bayer is committed to making SUNHARBO accessible. If a patient cannot afford their prescription, Bayer may be able to help. Eligible patients may receive their Bayer prescription medicine at no cost through the Bayer U.S. Patient Assistance Foundation. For more information, please visit www.patientassistance.bayer.us or call to speak with a member of Bayer’s team at 1-866-2BUSPAF (228-7723).

About SUNHARBO® (asundexian)
SUNHARBO is a once-daily, first-in-class, oral Factor XIa inhibitor approved by the U.S. FDA and indicated in combination with antiplatelet therapy to reduce the risk of stroke in adults with recent non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke (NIHSS≤15) or high-risk transient ischemic attack (TIA). SUNHARBO is the first approved Factor XIa inhibitor in the U.S. and represents the first medicine in a new class designed to target Factor XIa. SUNHARBO is an inhibitor of Factor XIa. Factor XIa inhibition reduces amplification of thrombin generation. In preclinical models, Factor XIa inhibition targets more pathological clotting (thrombosis) with lesser impact on normal clotting response (hemostasis).1

SUNHARBO was approved based on results from the pivotal Phase 3 OCEANIC-STROKE study where SUNHARBO significantly reduced ischemic stroke in patients after a recent non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke or high-risk transient ischemic attack compared to placebo (6.2% vs. 8.4%; HR 0.74; 95% CI, 0.65–0.84; P<0.0001), both in combination with antiplatelet therapy.1

For additional information about SUNHARBO, healthcare professionals may visit SUNHARBOhcp.com. Please see the full prescribing information.

IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION

CONTRAINDICATIONS and WARNINGS & PRECAUTIONS
None.

ADVERSE REACTIONS
Bleeding

  • The rate of International Society on Thrombosis and Haemostasis (ISTH) major bleeding was similar between SUNHARBO and placebo groups (1.6 vs. 1.5 per 100 patient-years).

  • The rate of ISTH major bleeding events within 90 days of treatment initiation was 4.5 vs. 3.1 per 100 patient-years in the SUNHARBO and placebo groups, respectively.

  • In patients planned to receive DAPT, the rate of ISTH major bleeding events was 1.9 vs. 1.5 per 100 patient-years in the SUNHARBO and placebo groups, respectively.

  • Among patients older than 75 years, the rate of ISTH major bleeding was 2.6 vs. 1.7 per 100 patient-years in the SUNHARBO and placebo groups, respectively.

  • In the high-risk TIA subgroup, the rate of ISTH major bleeding was 2.9 vs. 1.0 per 100 patient-years in the SUNHARBO and placebo groups, respectively.

  • The rate of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding was higher in the SUNHARBO compared to placebo group (2.7 vs. 2.1 per 100 patient-years). The majority of GI bleeding events in the SUNHARBO group (74%) were clinically relevant non-major or minor bleeding, and the most frequent bleeding site was of rectal origin.

Diarrhea

  • The most frequently reported (> 3%) adverse reaction in SUNHARBO-treated patients was diarrhea.

Hepatic Enzyme Increased

  • SUNHARBO is associated with elevated hepatic enzymes. Substantial cholestatic liver injury or serious liver injury with jaundice were each reported in less than 0.02% of SUNHARBO-treated patients.

DRUG INTERACTIONS

  • P-glycoprotein (P-gp) substrates - Concomitant use of SUNHARBO increased the exposure to digoxin. For digoxin and sensitive P-gp substrates where minimal concentration changes may increase the risk of adverse reactions, follow the recommendation in their approved product labeling.

  • Combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inducers - Avoid concomitant use with combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inducers, which decreases SUNHARBO exposure and may lead to loss of efficacy.

USE IN SPECIFIC POPULATIONS

Pregnancy

  • There are risks to the mother associated with untreated non-cardioembolic ischemic stroke or TIA and risk of bleeding in the mother and fetus or neonate associated with use of anticoagulants during pregnancy.

Lactation

  • Breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment with SUNHARBO and for 5 days after the last dose due to the potential for serious adverse reactions in nursing infants, including bleeding.

Hepatic Impairment

  • Patients with moderate to severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh B and C) may have intrinsic coagulation abnormalities and use of SUNHARBO in these patients is not recommended.

For additional important risk and use information, please see the full Prescribing Information.

You are encouraged to report side effects or quality complaints of prescription drugs to the FDA. Visit www.fda.gov/medwatch or call 1-800-FDA-1088.

About Bayer’s Stroke Franchise
Bayer is a leader in cardiovascular (CV) and cerebrovascular diseases, with a longstanding legacy of scientific innovation in the prevention and treatment of thrombotic conditions. Building on this heritage, Bayer is advancing innovative approaches to help address unmet needs in stroke, with a focus on the area of secondary stroke prevention and research into new pathways, including Factor XIa. Bayer aims to help shape the future of stroke care with products strategically positioned to help address critical unmet needs and drive significant long-term value. Bayer is working alongside the stroke community to better understand unmet needs and support patients and care partners across the stroke journey.

Bayer is a global enterprise with core competencies in the life science fields of health care and nutrition. In line with its mission, “Health for all, Hunger for none,” the company’s products and services are designed to support efforts to master major challenges presented by a growing and aging global population and create value through innovation and growth. The Bayer brand stands for trust, reliability and quality throughout the world. In fiscal 2025, the Group employed around 88,000 people and had sales of 45.6 billion euros. data.title: Apartments.com Releases Multifamily Construction Activity Update for Q3 2026
data.description:
Apartments.com, an industry-leading online marketplace of CoStar Group, Inc. (), released its latest U.S. multifamily construction activity update for the third quarter of 2026.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261120681612/en/

National apartment construction starts totaled about 76,000 units in Q3 2026, down 63% from the peak of nearly 206,000 units in Q1 2022 and the lowest quarterly total since 2012. Over the past 12 months, starts totaled about 342,000 units, the lowest annual pace since 2014 and roughly three-quarters of the units delivered over the same period.

As a result, the pipeline continues to shrink. About 593,000 units were under construction nationwide in the third quarter. That is roughly half the early 2023 peak of nearly 1.2 million and the 14th consecutive quarterly decline, returning the pipeline to mid-2016 levels.

"Developers are still breaking ground on far fewer projects than they're finishing, and that gap is reshaping the supply outlook market by market," said Grant Montgomery, national director of U.S. multifamily analytics at CoStar Group. "In places where starts have pulled back the furthest, the wave of new apartments that defined the past few years is giving way to a much thinner pipeline ahead."

Completions are also easing. About 446,000 units were delivered over the past four quarters, down 22% from a year earlier and 36% below the 2024 peak.

At the market level, New York City has the largest pipeline at about 46,000 units, followed by Dallas-Fort Worth at roughly 32,000. Relative to existing inventory, Miami leads with about 9% of its apartment stock under construction, followed by Charlotte and Fort Lauderdale at more than 6%.

The pullback is especially sharp in Texas, home to three of the six most active markets for apartment starts during the building boom. Combined starts over the past 12 months across Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, Austin and San Antonio are down about 42% from a year earlier.

data.title: Nasdaq set for lower open as Anthropic retreat deepens AI jitters
data.description:
Key points:
  • Futures down: Dow 0.48%, S&P 500 1.17%, Nasdaq 2.16%
  • Anthropic down 13.5% a day after debut
  • Intuit down after company cuts revenue forecast, agrees to sell unit

By Utkarsh Hathi and Ragini Mathur

The Nasdaq was set for a lower open on Friday as Anthropic shares retreated after a blockbuster debut, undermining hopes that the listing would stabilize an AI trade already shaken by valuation concerns, while hawkish signals from Federal Reserve officials this week also weighed on sentiment.

Anthropic shares dropped 13.5% in premarket trading after surging more than 17% on Thursday in their highly anticipated market debut.

The AI lab's IPO and Nvidia's earnings this week were seen as key tests of whether battered investor confidence in the AI trade could recover.

But neither revived enthusiasm after weeks of concern about the profitability of massive AI infrastructure spending, rising borrowing costs, regulatory risks following Democrats' win in the US midterm elections, and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's departure.

The main US stock indexes were on track for their steepest weekly decline since April 2025, when US President Donald Trump announced Liberation Day tariffs.

"Markets are entering a more defensive phase," said Daniela Hathorn, senior market analyst at Capital.com.

"Strong AI demand and successful individual listings are no longer sufficient to sustain broader risk appetite when investors are questioning valuations, borrowing costs and the outlook for corporate profitability."

Among hyperscalers, Amazon and Microsoft declined more than 2% each, while Meta fell 4.5% and Alphabet was down 0.8%. Amazon and Alphabet are among Anthropic's biggest investors.

Nvidia fell 3.7%, with shares in the chipmaker heading for their longest weekly losing streak since 2008.

Advanced Micro Devices , Broadcom , Marvell , and Micron lost between 3.6% and 7%.

Neocloud firms CoreWeave and Nebius also dropped about 6% each.

Data center stocks IREN , Applied Digital and Core Scientific fell about 5% each.

At 8:41 a.m. ET, Dow E-minis (YMcv1) were down 235 points, or 0.48%, and S&P 500 E-minis were down 84.5 points, or 1.17%. Nasdaq 100 E-minis were down 574 points, or 2.16%.

As of Thursday's close, the Nasdaq was 13.6% below its October 6 record closing high, while the S&P 500 CBOE:SPX had posted its sixth consecutive loss, its longest losing streak since April 2024.

The CBOE Volatility Index , Wall Street's fear gauge, was up 3 points on Friday, hitting the 30-point mark for the first time since March 30.

The selloff in AI-linked stocks has largely overshadowed a strong earnings season.

Of the 462 companies in the S&P 500 to have reported results through Wednesday, 83.5% beat analyst earnings expectations, according to an analysis from Tajinder Dhillon, head of earnings and equity research at LSEG Data and Analytics.

INFLATION, FED IN FOCUS

Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia President Anna Paulson said on Thursday the Fed will need to raise interest rates again because inflation is too high.

Markets are pricing in a 94.2% chance of an interest rate hike from the central bank at its next meeting in December, according to CME Group's FedWatch tool.

Attention will also be on Fed Governor Lisa Cook's speech, expected later in the day.

Next week's personal consumption expenditures (PCE) figures will provide further clarity on the Fed's monetary policy path after a hotter-than-expected October inflation report last week.

Among other movers, Intuit shares fell 9.7% after the company cut its annual revenue growth forecast and agreed to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for about $3.68 billion, five years after acquiring it for nearly three times as much.

data.description:
Polycab USA LLC, a subsidiary of Polycab India Limited, India’s No. 1 wires and cables company and a global industry leader, showcased its portfolio of specialised cable solutions at RE+ 2026, North America’s largest clean energy exhibition, held from November 17–19 at the Las Vegas Convention Center, USA.

The participation underscored Polycab's international ambitions and its focus on strengthening relationships with global customers, utilities, EPC contractors and infrastructure developers. With a presence across 94 countries, the company is expanding its international footprint through its manufacturing capabilities, technical expertise and diversified product portfolio.

Polycab recorded consolidated revenue of US$3.3 billion in FY26, registering year-on-year growth of 23%. Its export business recorded growth of 12% in USD terms over the previous year. The company's focus on international markets is supported by its manufacturing capabilities, product engineering expertise and ability to address evolving customer requirements across diverse applications.

At RE+ 2026, Polycab showcased solutions for the global energy ecosystem. The portfolio included solutions designed to meet relevant UL and ANSI standards, catering to applications across renewable energy, infrastructure, data centres, oil and gas, power transmission and distribution, and electric mobility.

RE+ brought together stakeholders from across the modern energy industry, with programming and business opportunities spanning solar, energy storage, hydrogen, microgrids, EV charging infrastructure and wind energy.

Commenting on the participation, Mr. Anurag Agarwal, CEO – Global Exports & New Businesses (EHV & Conductors), Polycab India Ltd., said:

"The US market presents opportunities across several sectors, including infrastructure, data centres, oil and gas, and renewable energy, driven by growing investments in energy and critical infrastructure. Polycab is focused on strengthening its presence in these segments by offering specialised cable solutions that meet relevant international standards and address evolving customer requirements. RE+ provided an important platform to showcase our capabilities, engage with industry stakeholders and build long-term partnerships."

For further information & claim, please visit www.polycab.com/export

data.title: Mercedes gets German approval for assisted point-to-point driving
data.description:
Mercedes-Benz said on Friday it had become the first automaker to receive regulatory approval for assisted point-to-point driving in Germany, a milestone in the race to deploy more advanced automated-driving systems on public roads.

The authorisation is the first granted in Germany under new UN rules governing advanced driver-assistance systems and comes as automakers compete to expand automated-driving functions beyond limited highway use.

The approval covers Mercedes' MB.DRIVE ASSIST PRO system, which extends driving assistance from motorways to city streets while requiring drivers to stay in control of the vehicle.

The carmaker said it would launch an early-access programme in Stuttgart and Munich in late 2026 ahead of a broader German rollout in the first half of 2027.

Mercedes said the technology could later be rolled out in other countries that adopt the UN rules, which are due to take effect in January 2027.

Mercedes already offers its Drive Pilot system, which allows drivers to look away from the road under some conditions. The newly approved system is less autonomous but can be used in a wider range of driving situations, including city traffic.

data.title: American Airlines, Israir Airlines to Partner on Travel between U.S. and Israel
data.description:
By Kelly Cloonan

American Airlines said it is working with Israir Airlines to improve travel options between the U.S. and Israel, ahead of the carrier's plans to resume service from New York to Tel Aviv after more than three years.

Under the partnership, announced Friday, Israir expects to place its code on American's nonstop flights between New York's John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) and Tel Aviv (TLV), which would allow its customers to book flights to New York on days it doesn't offer service.

American plans to resume daily service between JFK and TLV starting March 27, 2027. The carrier stopped offering those flights in 2023 following the outbreak of the war in Gaza.

Israir operates five weekly flights between JFK and TLV.

Additionally, the companies said they would work on an agreement which would allow Israir customers to use JFK to connect to American flights to other destinations across the U.S., Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean.

Following the initial phase, the airlines said they would look into other opportunities to expand the codeshare agreement and provide additional travel benefits for American's loyalty members.

"This partnership will help us deliver a stronger customer proposition in the market and create more opportunities for Israir's travelers to connect beyond our JFK gateway," said American's senior vice president of alliances, Anmol Bhargava.

data.title: Azerbaijan's January - October oil exports via BTC pipeline fell 7.5%, data shows
data.description:
Azerbaijan's oil exports via the Baku-Tbilisi-Ceyhan pipeline fell 7.5% to 21.1 million metric tons in the ten months to October 31, official data showed on Friday.

  • Azerbaijan's total oil transit amounted to 27.5 million tons in the first ten months of 2026, with 76.7% shipped via the BTC pipeline, according to the country's statistics committee.

  • The BTC pipeline, which runs through Georgia to Turkey, is used to export oil from the Azeri, Chirag and Guneshli oilfields operated by SOCAR.

  • Transit oil volumes from Kazakhstan and Turkmenistan shipped via the BTC pipeline rose to 3.8 million tons over the ten month period, against 3.4 million tons a year earlier, the data showed.

data.description:
• Total revenues decreased by 22.2% year-over-year to RMB243.0 million (US$36.2 million)[1].
  • Net income was RMB49.3 million (US$7.3 million)[1] compared to RMB59.0 million for the third quarter of 2025.
  • Core net income[3] was RMB55.4 million (US$8.3 million)[1], compared to RMB78.6 million for the third quarter of 2025.
  • Net cash provided by operating activities increased 29.1% year-over-year to RMB186.5 million (US$27.8 million)[1].

SHANGHAI, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- GreenTree Hospitality Group Ltd. () ("GreenTree", the "Company", "we", "us" and "our"), a leading hospitality and restaurant management group in China, today announced its unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026.

Third Quarter of 2026 Operational Highlights

Hotels

  • A total of 4,651 hotels with 333,590 hotel rooms were in operation as of September 30, 2026.
  • The Company opened 59 hotels in the third quarter of 2026 and had a pipeline of 1,313 hotels contracted for or under development as of September 30, 2026.
  • The average daily room rate was RMB165, a decrease of 5.0% from RMB173 in the third quarter of 2025.
  • The occupancy rate was 68.1%, decreased from 71.3% in the third quarter of 2025.
  • Revenue per available room, or RevPAR, was RMB112, a 9.3% year-over-year decrease.

Restaurants

  • A total of 203 restaurants were in operation as of September 30, 2026.
  • The AC (average check) was RMB37, a 1.6% year-over-year decrease.
  • The ADT (average daily tickets) was 62, decreased from 100 in the third quarter of 2025.

Recent Developments

Acquisition of Shanghai Yangpu Riverside Property

In late August 2026, the Company took possession of a riverfront property in Yangpu District, Shanghai, which it acquired through a competitive bidding process for total consideration of approximately RMB1.31 billion. The acquisition was funded primarily by long-term bank borrowings of approximately RMB917.0 million, on terms the Company considers favorable, with the balance already paid from cash on hand. As of September 30, 2026, the Company held RMB1,794.3 million in cash and cash equivalents, restricted cash, short-term investments and time deposits.

The property has a total floor area of approximately 50,000 square meters and fronts the Huangpu River in the Yangpu Riverside area, one of Shanghai's main technology corridors and home to the regional headquarters of a number of leading internet platform and artificial intelligence companies. Riverfront properties of this scale in the area rarely come to market, and comparable space is generally unavailable for lease or available only at high rents.

The Company plans to convert the property into an upscale flagship hotel of approximately 360 rooms, together with a lifestyle and commercial center of approximately 20,000 square meters that will serve hotel guests and the surrounding business community. Conversion work is under way, and the Company targets opening by the end of 2027.

The Company believes the acquisition price is well below the property's replacement cost and expects the project to generate attractive returns on its investment. The Company also expects the property to:

  • serve as a showcase for its upscale hotel brand to franchisees and partners;
  • house part of its corporate offices; and
  • provide a venue for franchisee conferences and events, which the Company expects will reduce certain selling and marketing costs over time.

The Company remains committed to its franchise-led, asset-light model. This acquisition is a selective investment in a flagship asset intended to support the growth of its upscale franchise business, and it does not affect the share repurchase program described below.

Acquisition of Kuala Lumpur Property

In July 2026, the Company took possession of a hotel property located opposite the Petronas Twin Towers in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, which it agreed to acquire in 2025. The property will serve as the Company's flagship in Malaysia and as a base for expanding its hotel network across Southeast Asia.

Share Repurchase Program

The Board of Directors has approved a share repurchase program authorizing the Company to repurchase up to US$5 million of its Class A ordinary shares over a two-year period, effective from the date of approval. Repurchases may be conducted through open market transactions at prevailing market prices, privately negotiated transactions, block trades or other legally permitted methods, at the Company's discretion, subject to market conditions, applicable securities laws and regulations, and the trading price of the Company's ADSs.

As of November 18, 2026, the Company had repurchased 62,922 of its ADSs for an aggregate repurchase price of US$61,396.74. The Company plans to continue its ADS repurchases under the program (which has unutilized capacity of approximately US$4.94 million), subject to market conditions, applicable law (including Rule 10b-18) and the Company's insider trading policy. The program may be suspended, modified or terminated at any time at the Board's discretion without prior notice.

Continued Listing Notice from NYSE

The Company received a letter from the New York Stock Exchange (the "NYSE"), dated November 4, 2026, notifying the Company that it was not in compliance with applicable price criteria in the NYSE's continued listing standards because, as of November 3, 2026, the average closing price of the Company's American Depositary Shares (the "ADSs") was less than US$1.00 per ADS over a consecutive 30 trading-day period.

Pursuant to Section 802.01C of the NYSE's Listed Company Manual, the Company has six months (the "Cure Period") following receipt of the notice to regain compliance with the minimum share price requirement. The Company can regain compliance at any time during the Cure Period if on the last trading day of any calendar month during the Cure Period the Company has a closing share price of at least US$1.00 per ADS and an average closing share price of at least US$1.00 per ADS over the 30 trading-day period ending on the last trading day of that month. In the event that at the expiration of the Cure Period, both a US$1.00 per ADS closing share price on the last trading day of the Cure Period and a US$1.00 per ADS average closing share price over the 30 trading-day period ending on the last trading day of the Cure Period are not attained, the NYSE will commence suspension and delisting procedures.

The Company notified the NYSE on November 17, 2026 of its intent to cure the deficiency.

The Company is considering all available options to regain compliance with the NYSE's continued listing standards.

During the Cure Period, the Company's ADSs will continue to be listed and traded on the NYSE, subject to compliance with other NYSE continued listing standards and other rights of the NYSE to delist the ADSs. To the Company's knowledge, the Company is currently in compliance with all other NYSE continued listing standards. The NYSE notice does not affect the Company's business operations or its U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission reporting requirements.

Use of Non-GAAP Financial Measures

We believe that Adjusted EBITDA and core net income, as we present them, are useful financial metrics to assess our operating and financial performance before the impact of investing and financing transactions, income taxes and certain non-core and non-recurring items in our financial statements.

The presentation of Adjusted EBITDA and core net income should not be construed as an indication that our future results will be unaffected by other charges and gains we consider to be outside the ordinary course of our business.

The use of Adjusted EBITDA and core net income has certain limitations because it does not reflect all items of income and expenses that affect our operations. Items excluded from Adjusted EBITDA and core net income are significant components in understanding and assessing our operating and financial performance. Depreciation and amortization expense for various long-term assets, income tax and share-based compensation have been and will be incurred and are not reflected in the presentation of Adjusted EBITDA. Each of these items should also be considered in the overall evaluation of our results. Additionally, Adjusted EBITDA and core net income do not consider capital expenditures and other investing activities and should not be considered as a measure of our liquidity. We compensate for these limitations by providing the relevant disclosure of our depreciation and amortization, interest expense/income, gains/losses from investments in equity securities, income tax expenses, share-based compensation, share of loss in equity investees, subsidies and other relevant items both in our reconciliations to the corresponding U.S. GAAP financial measures and in our consolidated financial statements, all of which should be considered when evaluating our performance.

The terms Adjusted EBITDA and core net income are not defined under U.S. GAAP, and Adjusted EBITDA and core net income are not measures of net income, operating income, operating performance or liquidity presented in accordance with U.S. GAAP. When assessing our operating and financial performance, you should not consider this data in isolation or as a substitute for our net income, operating income or any other operating performance measure that is calculated in accordance with U.S. GAAP. In addition, our Adjusted EBITDA and core net income may not be comparable to Adjusted EBITDA and core net income or similarly titled measures utilized by other companies since such other companies may not calculate Adjusted EBITDA and core net income in the same manner as we do.

Reconciliations of the Company's non-GAAP financial measures, including Adjusted EBITDA and core net income, to the consolidated statement of operations information are included at the end of this press release.

About GreenTree Hospitality Group Ltd.

GreenTree Hospitality Group Ltd. ("GreenTree" or the "Company") () is a leading hospitality and restaurant management group in China. data.title: Metalite Expands Launay Property Along the Macamic Fault, Establishing Macamic-Authier Block as its Third Area of Gold Exploration
data.description:
(TheNewswire)

Mapped Macamic Fault Segments Total Approximately 30 km; Three High-Quality Exploration Blocks Across the Launay Property

TORONTO, ON – TheNewswire – November 20, 2026 – Metalite Resources Inc. (CSE: METL) (OTC: JNCCF) (FSE: D680) ("Metalite" or the "Company") is pleased to announce the acquisition of additional mineral claims in Québec’s Launay district, expanding its northwestern exploration footprint along the Macamic Fault. The expansion encompasses 59 new claims and applications1 covering approximately 3,352 hectares and strengthens the Company’s position in the Macamic-Authier Block, one of three principal gold exploration areas being advanced at Launay.

The expansion follows Metalite’s fall 2026 exploration and ongoing historical-data compilation, which highlighted structural trends, geological contacts and preliminary responses warranting further investigation along the northwestern corridor.

"Our work this fall has given us a clearer basis for expanding Launay and deciding where to focus next," said Alex Storcheus, Executive Chairman of Metalite. "Macamic-Authier brings together an important stretch of the fault corridor, a historical silver-lead showing and a substantial body of exploration information that we can now examine as an integrated package. Together with the Chauvignet and Lyndhurst blocks, it gives us three distinct areas in which to test our geological ideas and build the next generation of exploration targets."

Three Blocks, a Shared Geological Framework

Metalite has organized its Launay exploration activities around three blocks. Their current mapped outlines cover approximately 14,000 hectares in total, with the following areas and principal features:

  • Chauvignet Block (~5,015 ha). This central exploration block includes the flagship Trojan Zone, where 105 diamond drill holes have been reported, totalling approximately 21,826 metres.2 The extensive historical exploration provides a foundation for understanding the gold-exploration setting along the Macamic structural corridor and for evaluating sheared volcanic rocks, intrusive contacts and quartz-vein systems in the district.

  • Macamic-Authier Block (~4,978 ha). The northwestern focus of the current expansion lies in the Macamic–Authier area, extending toward Taschereau. Its attraction combines the Macamic Fault corridor, the historical Chemin de Fer-Sud silver–lead showing, a substantial archive of geological and geophysical work, and practical road and nearby rail access. Parts of the mapped block remain subject to claim-application approval.

  • Lyndhurst Block (~3,933 ha). The southeastern block includes the interpreted intersection area of the Lyndhurst and Macamic structural corridors, an important focus for examining how faults, volcanic contacts and alteration relate to one another. The predecessor’s 2021 airborne magnetic and VLF-EM survey covered the Lyndhurst grid, providing data for structural interpretation and follow-up.

Click Image To View Full Size

Metalite’s GIS analysis of the regional SIGÉOM Macamic Fault trace identifies approximately 29.9 kilometres of mapped fault segments (shown in red on the accompanying map) within the three block outlines: ~7.9 km at Chauvignet; ~13.2 km at Macamic-Authier; and ~8.9 km at Lyndhurst. The Launay Property lies in the Abitibi Greenstone Belt, where volcanic rocks, intrusive contacts and major deformation zones provide the geological setting for the Company’s exploration strategy. Numerous historic gold showing have been identified in close proximity and adjacent to the faults and shears in the region, including the Macamic Fault. The Macamic structure is a regional northwest-trending sheared corridor. Historical work at Launay describes quartz–carbonate–tourmaline veining and sulphides in altered, sheared volcanic rocks associated with the fault system and its subsidiary structures. These relationships support investigating deformation, alteration and vein development together, rather than treating individual anomalies in isolation.

As reported on October 28, 2026, Metalite’s integrated program combined satellite imagery, radar, terrain analysis, historical geological information and prospecting, supported by TerraEye’s specialist spectral work. The program identified multiple geological follow-up localities, including potential bedrock exposures, structural and contact relationships, and preliminary spectral responses requiring ground verification.

This work, together with the continuing assessment of historical data, supported the decision to expand along the northwestern continuation of the Macamic structural corridor. The objective is to bring promising geological relationships into a coherent exploration program, with a view to evaluating the potential continuity of mineralization at a district scale.

Macamic-Authier Block: Bringing Historical Reports into a Modern Compilation

Metalite has identified, analysed and digitized 88 historical assessment reports whose mapped coverage overlaps the Macamic-Authier Block. The collection includes a significant body of geophysical information, together with geological mapping and drilling records. Bringing these sources into a common digital framework allows the Company to compare historical responses with mapped structures, mineral occurrences and the current claim configuration. Preliminary findings include:

  • Drilling. The compilation identifies 24 historical drill holes totalling approximately 3,606 metres directly within the Macamic-Authier Block3

  • Chemin de Fer-Sud: A Historical Mineralized Showing. A 1962 report4 by Québec resident geologist Jean Dugas describes three principal quartz veins in chloritic schist, with pyrite and minor chalcopyrite and galena; tourmaline and carbonate were also observed in one vein. A historical sample from one of the veins was reported to return 0.17 g/t Au, 77 g/t Ag, 0.12% Cu and 1.15% Pb (these historic assay results have not been verified in the field by Metalite professionals).

  • Road and Rail Access. The block benefits from road access in the Macamic-Authier-Taschereau area, with a railway within a few hundred metres of portions of the property.

  • Public Land Tenure. Metalite estimates that approximately half of the outlined block overlies public land.

Click Image To View Full Size

Historical logs and survey data are being digitized to identify what has been tested, where coverage is incomplete and which anomalies merit renewed examination. Metalite is also integrating historical geophysical and geochemical data to assess similarities and differences relative to the Trojan Zone and other areas of documented gold mineralization5.

Next Steps

Metalite continues to advance its comprehensive compilation and interpretation of historical geological, geophysical and drilling data across the Launay Property, integrating these datasets with the results of its 2026 exploration program to refine and prioritize prospective exploration targets. This ongoing work is being undertaken with a view to finalizing the Company's drill permit applications and advancing its most prospective areas toward drill testing. Metalite has been working closely with its geological and permitting consultants to complete the necessary technical documentation and regulatory submissions, with the objective of positioning the Company to undertake targeted drilling programs, subject to receipt of the required approvals and available funding.

About Metalite Resources Inc.

Metalite Resources Inc. is a Canadian mineral exploration company focused on the acquisition, exploration and advancement of precious-metals projects. The Company owns a 100% interest in the Arthurs Seat Silver-Antimony Project in New South Wales, Australia and a 100% interest in the Launay Gold Property, a district-scale gold project located in Québec's Abitibi Greenstone Belt. The Company's strategy is to create long-term shareholder value through the systematic exploration and advancement of high-potential mineral properties.

data.title: Danaher Teams Up With Microsoft To Develop AI-Powered Scientific Instruments, First Applications Expected This Year
data.description:
Key points:
  • The platform will use Microsoft Azure for secure cloud infrastructure and Microsoft Foundry to power AI agents for instrument control and insight generation.
  • The technology is designed to help scientists plan experiments, guide instrument operations, interpret results, and recommend corrective actions under human oversight.
  • In preliminary internal testing, novice scientists using an AI assistant with a Leica microscope took up to 83% less time and 68% fewer steps than those working without the assistant, Danaher said.

Healthcare company Danaher Corporation (DHR) announced a strategic partnership with Microsoft (MSFT) on Friday to develop smart, AI-powered scientific instruments and an interoperable platform designed to connect laboratory technologies and make research workflows more intelligent.

"With Microsoft, we are building a common foundation, so our instruments and laboratories work together consistently, as one connected Danaher," Danaher CEO Julie Sawyer Montgomery said.

At the time of writing in premarket trading, DHR shares traded marginally lower, while MSFT shares traded 2.3% lower.

What The Partnership Involves

The partnership will focus on developing a common agentic platform for instrument control and insight generation. It will use Microsoft Azure for secure, compliant cloud infrastructure and Microsoft Foundry to power AI agents that interpret results and guide instrument control.

The technology is being designed to help scientists translate scientific questions into experimental plans, configure instruments and methods, guide experiment execution, troubleshoot issues, and recommend next steps for review. Instrument hardware will operate within defined safety boundaries and under user oversight.

The first commercial applications are expected to reach Danaher customers in 2026. These include MetaXpress Acquire AI Assistant, software from Danaher's Molecular Devices business for its high-content cellular imaging systems, designed to provide product support. Additional next-generation instruments using the platform are planned for 2027.

Danaher said the collaboration is part of its broader strategy to connect intelligence at scientific instruments with laboratory data, workflows and the execution of experiments. However, the company believes this could help scientists use experimental results to determine subsequent steps, supporting increasingly connected and autonomous research workflows under scientific oversight.

Early Testing Shows Potential Time Savings For Scientists

In preliminary internal testing, novice scientists conducting an AI-assisted experiment on a Leica microscope took up to 83% less time and up to 68% fewer steps to complete the experiment than novices working without the AI assistant, Danaher said. The company added that the participants produced high-quality data and completed the experiment in a time comparable to an expert.

Microsoft Executive Vice President and Chief Revenue Officer Deb Cupp said the partnership aims to give scientists more choice and control, while allowing them more time for discovery. She added that the collaboration aligns with Microsoft's goal of translating AI into real-world impact.

How Retail Views MSFT-DHR Partnership?

On Stocktwits, retail sentiment toward DHR remained in the ‘Bullish’ territory, with ‘Normal’ message volumes; however, sentiment toward MSFT remained in the ‘Bearish’ territory over the past 24 hours.

DHR shares are marginally lower year-to-date, while Microsoft shares have gained approximately 3%.

data.title: Utz Brands, Inc. and Intersnack Group GmbH & Co. KG Announce Completion of Transaction to Take Utz Private
data.description:
Utz Brands, Inc. (NYSE:UTZ) (“UBI” or the “Company”), a leading U.S. manufacturer of branded salty snacks, and Intersnack Group GmbH & Co. KG (“Intersnack Group” or “Intersnack”), a leading, multinational savory snack manufacturer, today announced the completion of the previously announced transaction pursuant to which Intersnack Group acquired all outstanding shares of Class A Common Stock of UBI for $14.25 per share, a premium of approximately 91% to the unaffected closing price on July 20, 2026. The closing of the transaction follows approval by UBI stockholders at the Company’s Special Meeting of Stockholders on November 13, 2026. UBI’s Class A Common Stock has ceased trading on the New York Stock Exchange and will be officially delisted. Following the closing of the transaction, the Utz business will be held by Utz Brands Holdings, LLC (“Utz Brands Holdings”).

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261119130284/en/

Utz Brands and Intersnack Group announce completion of the transaction to take Utz private.

This partnership between Intersnack Group and entities affiliated with Utz’s founding family marks a pivotal moment for Utz, maintaining Utz’s century-long history of family ownership while establishing Intersnack Group’s presence in the large and attractive U.S. snacking market. With Intersnack Group’s expertise in innovation and operations, Utz will be positioned to forge even stronger consumer relationships and support continued investment in its brands. Utz is well positioned to build on its strong foundation and deep U.S. market knowledge to accelerate long-term growth and create meaningful benefits for all of its stakeholders.

“Today marks the beginning of an important new chapter for Utz,” said Dylan Lissette, Executive Chairman of Utz Brands Holdings. “With affiliated entities of the Rice and Lissette Family and Intersnack Group as long-term owners, Utz has a committed ownership structure focused on preserving what makes the Company special while supporting its continued evolution. Intersnack’s experience and capabilities add meaningful depth and agility to our organization and will support our efforts to enhance our brands, improve our operations and pursue opportunities for sustainable growth. We are grateful to our associates, customers, suppliers and communities whose contributions have shaped Utz’s success.”

“The completion of our partnership with the Rice and Lissette family represents an important milestone for Intersnack,” said Johan van Winkel, Executive Chairman of Intersnack Group. “We share a long-term perspective and a strong belief in the potential of Utz’s brands and people. By bringing our complementary strengths together, we can support Utz’s next phase of growth while creating new opportunities for both partners.”

Advisors

Special Committee and Company:

Citi was lead financial advisor, serving as exclusive financial advisor to the Special Committee of the Board of Directors of Utz, and Sidley Austin LLP served as legal counsel to the Special Committee. RBC Capital Markets served as a financial advisor to Utz.

The Rice and Lissette Family:

Sageworth served as financial advisor to the Rice and Lissette Family, and Cozen O’Connor served as legal counsel to the Rice and Lissette Family.

Intersnack Group:

BofA Securities served as exclusive financial advisor to Intersnack Group and provided committed debt financing in support of the transaction. Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP served as legal counsel to Intersnack Group.

About Utz Brands, Inc.

Utz Brands, Inc. (NYSE:UTZ) manufactures a diverse portfolio of savory snacks through popular brands, including Utz®, On The Border® Chips & Dips, Zapp’s®, and Boulder Canyon®, among others. After over a century with a strong family heritage, Utz continues to have a passion for exciting and delighting consumers with delicious snack foods made from top-quality ingredients. Utz’s products are distributed nationally through grocery, mass merchandisers, club, convenience, drug, and other channels. Based in Hanover, Pennsylvania, Utz has multiple manufacturing facilities across the U.S. to serve its growing customer base. For more information, please visit www.utzsnacks.com or call 1-800-FORSNAX.

About Intersnack Group

With nearly 60 years’ experience, Intersnack Group is one of the leading snack manufacturers in Europe and Oceania. The Group has grown continuously in recent years, both organically and through acquisition, becoming a market leader in savoury snacks. It operates 44 production sites across Europe, Australia, New Zealand, employs around 14,500 people and generated sales of approximately €4.5 billion/$5.0 billion in 2025.

Intersnack is passionate about enriching lives with great tasting snacks. Its portfolio spans potato chips, nuts, baked snacks and specialties and includes many well-loved local and international brands such as funny-frisch, Chio, POM-BÄR, Estrella, Hula Hoops, Tyrrell’s, Vico, Griffin's and Whole Earth.
